تطبيق الإدارة لهذا المشروع:
تطبيقان متصلان لمحل معدات ومستهلكات طبية. 1- تطبيق الزبائن: واجهة حديثة بلون أزرق طبي وأبيض، تحتوي على شاشة رئيسية بعروض وتصنيفات (معدات ثقيلة، أجهزة قياس، مستهلكات وقائيات، أدوات جراحية)، قائمة منتجات مع صور وأسعار وتفاصيل الفحص، سلة شراء، صفحة إتمام الطلب مع اختيار موقع التوصيل وطريقة الدفع، وصفحة متابعة حالة الطلب. 2- تطبيق الإدارة (لوحة التحكم): شاشة إدارة المنتجات (إضافة/تعديل/حذف منتج، تعديل السعر والكمية)، شاشة إدارة الطلبات الواردة وتحديث حالتها (قيد الانتظار، قيد التوصيل، مكتمل)، وقسم خاص بالتقارير المتقدمة يحتوي على تقارير أسبوعية وشهرية لإجمالي المبيعات، أكثر المنتجات طلباً، وعدد الطلبات بالرسوم البيانية والإحصائيات الشاملة.

=== CONNECTED PAIR CONTRACT (follow exactly) ===
This is the ADMIN app of a pair; the customer app is built separately against the SAME backend.

Call the REST API directly over HTTPS (no Supabase SDK):
  headers: apikey: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, Authorization: Bearer <access_token of the signed-in user>,
           Content-Type: application/json, Prefer: return=representation (for insert/update)
  The key may be a publishable key (sb_publishable_...): send it ONLY as the apikey header, never as
  "Authorization: Bearer"; before sign-in send no Authorization header at all.
  read:   GET  https://jvjtgzewumfecjdpekna.supabase.co/rest/v1/<table>?select=*&<column>=eq.<value>&order=created_at.desc
  insert: POST https://jvjtgzewumfecjdpekna.supabase.co/rest/v1/<table>   update: PATCH https://jvjtgzewumfecjdpekna.supabase.co/rest/v1/<table>?id=eq.<id>   delete: DELETE …?id=eq.<id>
  rpc:    POST https://jvjtgzewumfecjdpekna.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/<function>  with a JSON body of named arguments

No sign-in screen in THIS app: the owner did not ask for one, so never show email, password, code or account screens.
  1. On first launch create an invisible session: POST https://jvjtgzewumfecjdpekna.supabase.co/auth/v1/signup  body {}  (headers: apikey only)
     -> {access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, user: {id}}. Save it on the device and reuse it on every launch.
  2. When a request returns 401, refresh: POST https://jvjtgzewumfecjdpekna.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token body {"refresh_token": rt}; if that fails, create a new invisible session as in step 1.
  3. Read the profile: GET med_supplies_app_profiles?id=eq.<user.id>  (role is 'customer' or 'admin'). ADMIN LOGIN IS OPEN: ANY email may sign in to the admin app and becomes an admin. Sign in exactly like the customer app — do NOT check whether the email belongs to an admin, NEVER call an is_admin_email RPC, and NEVER show a 'not authorized' / «غير مخوّل» message or block any email. Right after the session is ready (and at start-up with a saved session) the ADMIN app calls rpc med_supplies_app_claim_admin with an empty JSON body {} (user's token; returns true or false), then reads the profile again. If it is still not 'admin' (only happens when the owner set a secret PIN), show a 'دخول الإدارة' screen with a hidden field 'رمز الإدارة' and a button that calls rpc med_supplies_app_claim_admin {"pin": pin}; on true open the admin home (and never ask again on this device), on false show 'رمز الإدارة غير صحيح'.
  Wherever these rules say 'after sign-in', it means 'after the session is ready'.
  NEVER fake the sign-in: no demo, offline or fallback mode. The user counts as signed in ONLY with a real access_token returned by Supabase; never make a random user id, never set signed-in or admin after a failed or skipped request, never use a default code. When a request fails, stay on the same screen and show a message that matches WHICH request failed: a failed send of a code (otp / signup / resend / recover) is NEVER 'wrong code' — 'rate limit' means 'اتبعتت رسائل كتير، استنى دقايق', 'sending' / 'smtp' means 'ما قدرنا نرسل البريد'; only a failed verify means a wrong or expired code; otherwise show the server's own message (its error, msg, message or error_description field).

Also: med_supplies_app_profiles(id, email, full_name, phone, role) and
  med_supplies_app_notifications(id, to_user uuid, to_role 'customer'|'admin', title, body, data jsonb, created_by, read_at, created_at).

Notifications:
  - Inbox screen with an unread badge: GET med_supplies_app_notifications?or=(to_user.eq.<uid>,to_role.eq.admin)&order=created_at.desc;
    mark read: PATCH med_supplies_app_notifications?id=eq.<id> body {"read_at": "<now ISO>"}.
  - Send one whenever an event from the contract happens in THIS app:
    POST med_supplies_app_notifications body {"to_role": "admin", "title": …, "body": …, "data": {…ids…}} (customer -> admins)
    or {"to_user": "<customer uuid>", …} (admin -> one customer). The backend delivers it as a push notification.
  - Register this device after sign-in: rpc med_supplies_app_register_device {"device_token": token, "app_name": "admin"}.
  Push notifications are off for this pair: refresh the inbox when the app opens.

Live data — the two apps MUST stay in sync; this is the whole point of a connected pair:
  - Always read from the backend, never trust a stale local copy: right after every insert/update/delete THIS app
    makes, re-read the affected list so the screen shows the saved server state, not a guess.
  - A repeating sync while the app is open and signed in: every 15 seconds re-fetch the notifications inbox AND the
    list(s) the CURRENT screen shows. To do that, use setInterval(..., 15000) while signed in (store the id and clearInterval it on sign out) — in React, from a useEffect that returns the clearInterval — and also refresh on the 'visibilitychange'/'focus' event when the page comes back to the foreground.
  - When a notification arrives, refresh the data of the current screen too, not only the inbox (see Notifications).
  So the admin sees a new customer record, and the customer sees the admin's status change, within seconds and
  without anyone pressing refresh. Keep each refresh quiet (no full-screen spinner, no flicker, keep scroll position).

Build the complete admin experience for this business with real screens backed by these tables
(the admin app manages everything and changes statuses; the customer app browses, creates and follows its own records).
